title: Electrostatics
content: Electrostatics is the study of electric charge at rest.
e: Electrostatics is the study of electric charge at rest. Electrostatics is charge at rest. Like charges push apart involving electric.

title: Electrodynamics
content: Electrodynamics is the study of moving electric charges and their interaction with magnetic and electric fields.
e: Electrodynamics is the study of moving electric charges and their interaction with magnetic and electric fields. Electrodynamics is measured or named exactly that way in this chapter.

title: Electric Current
content: Flow of charges is called an electric current.
e: Flow of charges is called an electric current. Electric Current is the flow of electric charge. Current is charge passing a point per second.

title: Conductor
content: The substance which has plenty of free electrons is called a conductor.
e: The substance which has plenty of free electrons is called a conductor. Conductor is a material with plenty of free electrons. A conductor has plenty of free electrons, so charge can move.

title: Insulator
content: The substance which has very few (or) no free electrons is called an insulator.
e: The substance which has very few (or) no free electrons is called an insulator. Insulator is a material with almost no free electrons. An insulator has almost no free electrons, so charge stays put.

title: Semiconductor
content: Some substances which contain a moderate amount of free electrons are called semiconductors.
e: Some substances which contain a moderate amount of free electrons are called semiconductors. Semiconductor is a material with a moderate number of free electrons. A semiconductor sits between a conductor and an insulator.

title: Induction
content: Induction is the process of charging a conductor without any contact with the charged body.
e: Induction is the process of charging a conductor without any contact with the charged body. A conductor has plenty of free electrons, so charge can move involving charging.
